name: com.lassi.presentation.mediadirectory.LassiMediaPickerActivity
description: The Chat SDK media picker, powered by MindInventory's Lassi library, opens when chat or profile screens request media. It lets users select or capture an image or video, crop images when requested, and returns the chosen files.
disableEffect: Users cannot select or capture the images and videos used for chat attachments or profile pictures through this picker.
